About_&_Key_Points:
About
Incorporated in 1975, Balkrishna Paper Mills
Ltd is in the Paper & Paper Boards business
and trading of plastic & packaging materials.

Business Overview:

BPML used to manufacture coated duplex /triplex paper boards out of recycled wastepaper and pulp, at its facilities in Ambivili, Maharashtra. Currently, it is doing trading activities in sustainable plastic and packaging materials, and paper & paper board. The company is looking towards
possibility of entering into new areas of business to put to use the existing resources of the
company to the optimum level.
